title: Bo Kho Italian Style Beef Soup
description: A twist on the classic Vietnamese Beef Soup, Bo Kho is given an Italian flair with the addition of Italian seasonings and herbs.

ingredients.name: zesty italian seasoning
ingredients.notes: dried oregano, basil, and thyme blend

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, carrots, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add kho sauce, Italian seasoning, beef broth, and dried tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with grated parmesan cheese.
